Information sheet
Documents for a doctorate application
The following list contains all documents that must be uploaded for a doctorate application
(www.unibas.ch/application). Each file must be no larger than 20 MB. In addition to the documents
required for all doctorates (all faculties/institutes), specific additional documents are required depending
on the faculty. The list distinguishes between documents that must be provided when submitting the
application and documents that can be submitted by a later, specified deadline if not available at the time
of application.
Original documents created in a language other than German, French, Italian, or English are to be
uploaded together with a certified translation in German or English (no translation required for a
Maturität or secondary/high school leaving certificate). Please consult the binding specifications of the
President's Office of the University of Basel for certified translations: www.unibas.ch/certified-translation.

All faculties/institutes
